arguments.hypothesis: The issue lies in the getValueAsString() method in ParserMinimalBase.java not returning the expected value when the current token is VALUE_STRING.

arguments.reason_for_going_back: The previous fix attempt failed, and I need to reassess the bug before proposing a new fix.

arguments.code_snippet: public String getValueAsString(String defaultValue) throws IOException { if (_currToken == JsonToken.VALUE_STRING) { return getText(); } if (_currToken == null || _currToken == JsonToken.VALUE_NULL || !_currToken.isScalarValue()) { return defaultValue; } return getText(); }
